definition: Completed daily close-return runs partitioned into one, exactly two, and at least three sessions. One-session runs are checked for strictly opposite daily returns on both sides. Amplitude terciles are descriptive and fitted separately by direction and duration over the fixed snapshot.
context: MA direction at close immediately before the run. Countertrend run is turn-associated if opposite MA sign appears through its confirming reversal close; otherwise internal if all signs unchanged. Same-direction, flat and unavailable contexts stay separate.
futureAnchor: Pattern confirmation close; report next-session and N-session forward returns only when fully available. No trading-return claim.
